常用方法：

**基本流程：**
```bash
# 打开浏览器并导航到网页
playwright-cli open https://example.com

# 截图
playwright-cli screenshot

# 填写表单

# 勾选/取消勾选
playwright-cli check @eN
playwright-cli uncheck @eN

# 按键
playwright-cli press Enter

# 新标签页
playwright-cli tab-new https://example.com
playwright-cli tab-list   # 列出所有标签
playwright-cli tab-select 1  # 切换到第1个标签
```

**核心技巧：**
- `snapshot` 是最常用的第一步，用来获取元素引用（如 `@e1`、`@e2`）
- 引用也可以用 CSS selector: `playwright-cli click "button.submit"`
- 还能直接执行 JS：`playwright-cli eval "document.title"`
